messages:
alex: hey team — quick ping for eyes on PR #2217 (perf/routing). switches to a local quantized variant fallback and adjusts cache TTL from 60s -> 30s for short-lived prefixes. goal: reduce p99 routing latency and cut per-token cost. can someone take a look before tomorrow's regression run? https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2217 :eyes:
priya: @alex I'll take it tonight. is this urgent for the canary or just for cost cleanup?
jordan: sharing quick ask — do we have microbenchmark numbers? curious about cold-start vs steady-state impact.
lee: pinging @priya and @jordan — also watch for prefix cache invalidation behaviour, last time TTL tweaks caused extra regenerations in a few flows. :grimacing:
alex: thanks — not blocking canary but prefer merged before the regression job. numbers on my branch: local bench (1000 traces) shows ~18% p99 reduction on routing RTT and ~6% token cost reduction overall. no eval drift in our smoke prompts. pasted config diff:
```
- routing:
-  default_timeout: 500ms
-  cache_ttl: 60s
+ routing:
+  default_timeout: 450ms
+  cache_ttl: 30s
+  prefer_local_quant_fallback: true
```
jordan: can you paste the bench command you used? want to reproduce quickly.
alex: run `./scripts/bench_routing.sh --profile quant-local --n 1000 --seed 42` — uploads artifacts to CI artifacts link in the PR.
lee: main worry: if `prefer_local_quant_fallback` mismatches model signature, do we invalidate prefix cache? that would spike regen.
alex: good call — I added a safe-guard: if key mismatch, route to remote variant without evicting local cache. see snippet in PR under `route_decision.py` (lines ~120-156). it's a conservative check.
perf-bot: CI: perf/checks — baseline vs PR: p50 +1%, p95 -10%, p99 -18%, cost estimate -6%. all unit tests passed. (build 8421)
priya: reviewed. small nit: change one log from DEBUG->INFO for obs. otherwise LGTM. adding :thumbsup:
jordan: left a comment about adding a tiny integration test for the mismatch path. not blocking.
lee: can we do a 5% canary in us-west for 24h and watch regen counts? I'll coordinate infra rollout if we merge.
alex: yes — plan: merge after Priya's tiny log change, trigger canary 5% us-west, monitor `routing.regen_rate` and `latency.p99`. fallback policy remains for 7 days then widen if stable.
priya: pushed the log change. re-running CI.
perf-bot: CI: all checks green. mergeable. (build 8430)
jordan: thanks all — will watch metrics during canary.
lee: will prepare infra change window for canary deploy.
alex: merging now. thanks everyone. :party:
